title: Spare Key — Chapter 5
narration: Sophie gave Adam's key to Claire, not me. Daddy chose, she said. Claire unlocked a maintenance shed beside the grave. Inside, we found a suitcase packed with my clothes, her medication, and three passports. Two showed Claire's face. The third belonged to Adam. Its photograph had been taken after his funeral. Claire insisted it proved he was alive, but something bothered me. Adam's wedding ring was on his right hand. In every photograph, he wore it on his left. The picture is reversed, I said. Sophie stopped smiling. I checked the burner phone. Its camera mirrored every image. Then I opened the crash video. In the reflection of the burning car, three adults were running away. Claire. Me. And the person filming. Sophie grabbed the phone, but I saw his face. It wasn't Adam. It was the surgeon who reconstructed mine. My phone rang. Evelyn, he whispered, ask Claire why she chose your face.
